mprMEPTap.Description: A set of tools for working with taps of engineering systems
mprMEPTap.Description1: Replacing a tee with a tap and a tap with a tee while keeping the original position of the main run
mprMEPTap.t1: Select tees and taps to replace
mprMEPTap.err1: Failed to parse the tee: it must have three end connectors, two of which lie on the same axis, with straight main run and branch segments connected to them
mprMEPTap.err2: Failed to parse the tap: the main run and the branch must be connected to it
mprMEPTap.err3: The main run and the branch must be straight segments, and the main run segments must lie on the same line
mprMEPTap.err4: The main run segments have different types or sizes and cannot be joined
mprMEPTap.err5: Breaking the main run is supported for ducts and pipes only
mprMEPTap.err6: The tap is too close to the end of the main run: after breaking, the segment will be shorter than allowed
mprMEPTap.err7: The branch is too short to replace the junction
mprMEPTap.err8: Failed to get the main run type
mprMEPTap.err9: The main run type "{0}" is not available for editing. It may be owned by another user in the worksharing file
mprMEPTap.err10: No suitable fitting is defined in the routing preferences of type "{0}". Add a tap and a tee to the "Junctions" rule group
mprMEPTap.err11: Failed to find free connectors to create the junction
mprMEPTap.err13: Check the routing preferences for the specified types
mprMEPTap.err14: Failed to join the main run segments after removing the tee
mprMEPTap.err15: Failed to break the main run at the tap point
mprMEPTap.err16: Failed to set up the tee family "{0}" for a {1}° connection: make sure it is parametric and supports such an angle
mprMEPTap.err17: Failed to connect the tee to the pipes: a segment may be shorter than the tee extension
